Title: CDN features: country filtering, compression, and analytics

Body.Content:
We have released a set of Content Developer Network (CDN) features that will enable you to accomplish the following tasks:
  • Analyze CDN usage patterns
  • Restrict access to your content by country
  • Improve performance by compressing files
These tasks can be accomplished by using the Supplemental Portal. To get to the Supplemental portal, go to the Azure portal and click the Manage CDN button (available when CDN is enabled for your service). Manage CDN can be found in the drawer and on the configuration tab for CDN and Media Services extensions. For more information, see the Media Services blog.
